name: The Gregory household at 1638 Prairie Avenue
head: pa1904_gregory_robert_b

present_on_scene_date.note: The household is listed at 1638 Prairie Avenue in both the 1904 and 1905 editions of the Blue Book, which bracket 1 July 1904, but not with the same people: the 1905 list prints 1638 Mr. & Mrs. Robert B. Gregory; Miss Eleanor Gregory. Each person's own note says which of them the later list drops or adds.

associated_with.note: The Blue Book's Prairie Avenue street list prints the household at 1638, and the 1905 list again. The book gives no date the household came or went, so neither end is dated here.

not_in_this_household.note: WHO IS NOT ON THIS CARD, AND WHY. The Blue Book is a society register: it names the family members who received and were received, prints unmarried daughters only as '& dr.', and names no young children, servants, coachmen, cooks or nurses. The 1900 census (ED 36, T623 roll 245) was read for this card. The two children it lists at the house on 1 June 1900 are on the card, graded inferred because the count was taken four years before the scene. Left off: Mary J. Greatbach (a boarder (a reader by trade), not family or staff, and a boarder in 1900 says little about 1904); Patrick McCullough (heads his own family of six in the rear house, with no stable trade the sheet ties to the house). The 1910 census was not read. A person goes on this card when a source names them, and not before.

persons.name: Robert B. Gregory
persons.note: The 1900 census lists Robert D. Gregory here as head, born August 1849, in Michigan, married, dealer, musical instruments (ED 36, sheet 2A, line 24, leaf n667).

persons.name: Mrs. Robert B. Gregory
persons.note: The 1900 census lists Ida Gregory here as wife, born June 1857, in Illinois, married (ED 36, sheet 2A, line 25, leaf n667).

persons.name: Mrs. Elizabeth Gregory
persons.note: Listed at 1638 in the 1904 edition only. The Blue Book does not say how she was related to Robert B. Gregory. The 1900 census lists Elizabeth Gregory here as mother, born January 1820, in Michigan, widowed (ED 36, sheet 2A, line 29, leaf n667).

persons.name: Eleanor Gregory
persons.note: The 1904 edition prints 'Miss Gregory'; the 1905 edition prints 'Miss Eleanor Gregory' at the same number, which is taken as the same woman. Her relation to the head is not printed. The 1900 census lists Ellener Gregory here as daughter, born June 1882, in Illinois, single (ED 36, sheet 2A, line 26, leaf n667).

persons.name: Grace E. Gregory

born.note: The census gives December 1883, age 16 on 1 June 1900.

persons.note: Enumerated on 1 June 1900 in the house, as a daughter of the head; born December 1883, in Illinois, single. The 1904 Blue Book names no children, so a child at home in 1900 is placed here in 1904 by inference.

persons.name: Ruth Gregory

born.note: The census gives May 1888, age 12 on 1 June 1900.
